objectives.statement: Recognize the Norwegian letters å, ø, and y as separate vowel letters with separate sound clues.
Use single and double consonants as clues for long and short vowel sounds.
Recognize common silent-letter spellings in high-frequency words.
Recognize high-value spelling groups such as kj and sj as sound clues without over-reading every letter.

notes: Merged pronunciation awareness lesson for static exercises. Must focus on spelling/sound awareness, vowel length, silent letters, and high-value contrasts; do not pretend to replace audio practice.
